zh.title: 菲律賓航空敲定15架波音787-10訂單 另有5架購買權
zh.summary: 菲律賓航空敲定15架波音787-10訂單，並保留另購5架的權利。
body: 菲律賓航空已與波音敲定15架787-10夢幻客機的訂單，並取得另外5架的購買權。合約涵蓋客機與發動機，於2026年11月10日簽署。
所有客機將採用GE Aerospace的GEnx-1B發動機。AeroTime報導，此次簽約將2026年7月在Farnborough International Airshow首次公佈的購機承諾轉為確定訂單。
PAL Holdings總裁兼營運長Lucio C. Tan III表示，787-10將在航空公司更新與擴充機隊的計畫中扮演重要角色。Aerospace Global News報導，787客機預計要到2030年代才會交付。

en.title: Philippine Airlines finalizes 15 Boeing 787-10 orders, with rights for five more
en.summary: Philippine Airlines orders 15 Boeing 787-10s and retains purchase rights for five more.
body: Philippine Airlines has finalized an order with Boeing for 15 787-10 Dreamliners, with purchase rights for five more. The contracts for the aircraft and their engines were signed on November 10, 2026, according to AeroTime.
All the aircraft will be powered by GE Aerospace GEnx-1B engines. The agreement firmed up a commitment first announced at the Farnborough International Airshow in July 2026.

PAL Holdings President and Chief Operating Officer Lucio C. Tan III said the aircraft would play an important role in the airline’s plans to modernize and expand its fleet. Aerospace Global News reported that 787 deliveries are not expected until the 2030s.
